author: billyb2004
what_it_is: Beginner's game save with 77 cars, most pre-tuned for most Events in GT-Mode.
format: Max Drive / PowerSave save: 'Ps2PowerSave' header (CRC32 907cb9b0, matches), folder BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA, 4 files, LZARI stream 1523486 bytes unpacking to 1528760 bytes (1528584 bytes of file data)

title: GRAN TURISMO 4
Game data
save.times: none: a max file stores no file times

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'gran-turismo-4.8950.max' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
